text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Fufu, running alongside Cheval is a rare opportunity, so I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know how well I can keep up
with them, but... I'll give it everything I've got...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...Huh? I'm hanging in there better than I thought...
Their back isn't far away at all—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...Alright!
With this—even I can do it!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Crossing the finish line neck and neck...
...With *me*...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Phew~ Not bad, Cheval.
Looks like you've grasped another important trick.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I-It's nothing... I'm just doing the training
I was told to do, that's all..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. Maybe it's... because you've been working so hard for me, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (When I felt like I couldn't do anything... Trainer told me to focus on "what I CAN do"...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...They helped me realize what I'm capable of,
even if it's just little by little... That's why...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: You got yourself a wonderful Trainer, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
That's why... I have to live up to their expectations...
